columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Repository configuration can turn nominally safe commands into approval-bearing execution
columns.title_zh: 仓库配置可把名义安全命令变成需要审批的执行
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260820-001 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The change exposes a precise digital-employee governance invariant: command names alone are not sufficient safety evidence because repository configuration can redirect apparently read-only Git operations into helpers or external execution. The resulting approval decision must therefore bind to effective execution context or an explicit policy rule, rather than a static safe-command label. This is directly testable and materially distinct from the prior day's child-agent delegation topic.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260820-001，Skill 02 评分 46/50。该变更暴露了一个清晰的数字员工治理不变量：仅凭命令名称不能构成安全证据，因为仓库配置可能把看似只读的 Git 操作重定向到 helper 或外部执行。因此审批判断必须绑定实际执行上下文或显式策略规则，而不能依赖静态“安全命令”标签。该机制可直接测试，并且与前一日的子 Agent 委派主题明显不同。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify which Git commands were removed from the safe classification, which repository or environment configurations can alter effective execution, how unless-trusted and explicit execution-policy rules interact, the exact approval path before and after the change, and the regression tests proving fail-closed behavior. Do not generalize this into a claim that every Git invocation is dangerous outside the demonstrated configuration boundary.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查哪些 Git 命令被移出安全分类、哪些仓库或环境配置会改变实际执行、unless-trusted 与显式执行策略规则如何交互、变更前后的准确审批路径，以及哪些回归测试证明失败关闭；不得把该机制泛化为“所有 Git 调用都危险”的结论。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Cross-agent history reconstruction must scrub credential-bearing control calls
columns.title_zh: 跨 Agent 历史重建必须清除携带凭据的控制调用
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260820-009 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It exposes a concrete architecture boundary between local authentication control state and inter-agent message history: reconstructing a session for a remote A2A peer must not replay credential-request function calls that can carry serialized AuthConfig, OAuth client secrets or service-account keys. The mechanism turns history rendering into an explicit security transformation step rather than a transparent replay layer, with direct implications for multi-agent trust boundaries and auditability.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260820-009，Skill 02 评分 46/50。该变更暴露了本地认证控制状态与跨 Agent 消息历史之间的具体架构边界：为远端 A2A Peer 重建会话时，不能重放可能携带序列化 AuthConfig、OAuth 客户端密钥或服务账号密钥的凭据请求函数调用。这使历史渲染成为显式的安全转换步骤，而不再是透明回放层，对多 Agent 信任边界与审计具有直接意义。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify where credential-request calls enter session history, the exact reconstruction and forwarding path to RemoteA2aAgent peers, which fields or function calls are stripped, whether non-secret conversational context is preserved, ordering effects, compatibility implications and regression tests. Keep this demonstrated credential-scrubbing boundary distinct from broader end-to-end A2A confidentiality guarantees.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查凭据请求调用如何进入会话历史、RemoteA2aAgent 向远端 Peer 重建与转发的准确路径、哪些字段或函数调用被剔除、非秘密会话上下文是否保留、顺序影响、兼容性影响及回归测试；必须把已证明的凭据清除边界与更广泛的 A2A 端到端机密性保证区分开。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Artifact versions should become visible only through atomic publication
columns.title_zh: Artifact 版本应只通过原子发布进入可见状态
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260820-011 with Skill 02 score 45/50. The change provides a compact and reproducible durability pattern: write payload and metadata into a hidden pending location and expose the new artifact version only with one atomic rename, so concurrent or interrupted saves cannot make a partial directory appear as the latest valid version. It also explicitly documents the remaining power-loss durability boundary, making the mechanism unusually suitable for engineering verification rather than promotional interpretation.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260820-011，Skill 02 评分 45/50。该变更给出了一个紧凑且可复现的持久化模式：先把 payload 与 metadata 写入隐藏 pending 位置，再通过一次原子重命名让新 Artifact 版本可见，从而避免并发或中断保存把半成品目录暴露为“最新有效版本”。实现还明确记录了断电场景剩余的持久性边界，因此非常适合工程核验，而不是宣传式解读。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify pending-directory allocation, payload/metadata write order, atomic-rename assumptions, concurrent writer behavior, interrupted-save cleanup, latest-version discovery semantics, platform/filesystem constraints and the documented power-loss limitation. Do not infer transactional durability beyond the filesystem guarantees actually demonstrated.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 pending 目录分配、payload/metadata 写入顺序、原子重命名假设、并发写入行为、中断保存清理、最新版本发现语义、平台/文件系统约束及已记录的断电限制；不得推断超出实际文件系统保证的事务持久性。
